journey.name: move to spark
journey.description:
Verifies the post-update "Move to Spark" sheet and the move itself. With an LDK channel that can send at least 1,000 sats and Spark connected, Home shows the "Move To Spark" sheet once (testTag "MoveToSparkIntro"); Spending and Lightning Connections show a "Move To Spark" button (testTag "MoveToSpark") while the channel can still send. The move quotes the routing fee over the channel only, pays the amount to a new invoice of the user's own Spark wallet, and then offers to close the emptied connection. A wallet without such a channel never gets the sheet or the button.
The "too large to route" state (testTag "MoveToSparkTrySmaller") needs a route that cannot carry the balance; on a direct channel to the Spark service provider every amount routes, so it is covered by the quote's unit tests and the PR's manual test rather than here.
Precondition: dev build pointed at a local Spark regtest (spark-sdk regtest/local), and a wallet with an open channel to that stack's SSP Lightning node that holds most of its capacity on the wallet's side (open it from Lightning Connections, Manual Setup, with the node URI the stack prints). Start on the wallet home screen with the app freshly launched.

actions.action: Wait on Home and verify the "Move To Spark" sheet (testTag "MoveToSparkIntro") shows, saying Blocktank is closing its Lightning connections
Tap "Later" (testTag "MoveToSparkIntroLater") and verify the sheet closes
Relaunch the app, wait on Home and verify the sheet does not show again
Open the Spending wallet and verify the "Move To Spark" button (testTag "MoveToSpark") shows
Tap "Move To Spark" and verify the screen shows an amount (testTag "MoveToSparkAmount") and a routing fee (testTag "MoveToSparkFee")
Swipe to move (testTag "MoveToSparkSwipe") and verify "Moved to Spark" shows the moved amount (testTag "MoveToSparkMoved") and "Close Connection" (testTag "MoveToSparkClose")
Tap "Close Connection", then "Close" on the close confirmation, and verify Lightning Connections shows no open connection and the Spark balance grew by the moved amount
Go back to Home, open Spending and verify the "Move To Spark" button is gone
